class_name: 強調-問題なし-トイウ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Re-presents a noun to hold it up for attention: 今日という日 is "today, of all days" rather than merely 今日. When the same noun is repeated on both sides (店という店, 木という木) the frame sweeps the whole category, "every last shop". The nuance is emotional weight or exhaustiveness, so plain 今日は or 店が is the neutral alternative; this is not the quotative or naming という of 山田さんという人.

examples.ruby: 今日[きょう]という日[ひ]は、二度[にど]と戻[もど]ってこない。
examples.english: Today, this day of all days, will never come again.

examples.ruby: 祖父[そふ]という人[ひと]は、一度[いちど]も弱音[よわね]を吐[は]かなかった。
examples.english: My grandfather, the man he was, never once let out a word of complaint.

examples.ruby: 台風[たいふう]の翌朝[よくあさ]、店[みせ]という店[みせ]が閉[し]まっていた。
examples.english: The morning after the typhoon, every last shop was shuttered.
